title: Pure Chemicritter
summary: Chemicritter is a dual-Level (Level 2 and Level 8) Gemini archetype themed around chemical elements and molecular bonding. Catalyst Field allows Level 8 Gemini monsters like Poly-Chemicritter Dioxogre and Poly-Chemicritter Hydragon to be Normal Summoned without Tributing and grants an extra Gemini Normal Summon each turn to unlock their effects and summon Vola-Chemicritter Methydraco.

allow.Supervise: Equip Spell that immediately grants a Chemicritter Gemini monster its effects and revives a Normal/Gemini monster when sent to the GY.
allow.Gemini Ablation: Continuous Trap that discards a card to Special Summon any Gemini monster from the Deck with its effects unlocked.
allow.Dragon's Mirror: Banishes Gemini monsters from the field or GY to Fusion Summon Superalloy Beast Raptinus.
allow.Terraforming: Searches the essential Catalyst Field Spell.
allow.Superalloy Beast Raptinus: Fusion Monster that automatically grants all Gemini monsters on the field their effects without needing a second Normal Summon.

main: Level 2 Gemini that sends 1 Gemini monster from the Deck to the GY and adds 1 Gemini monster from the Deck to the hand.
Level 2 Gemini that discards 1 card to Special Summon 1 Gemini monster from the GY in Defense Position.
Level 2 Gemini that Special Summons a Gemini from hand and changes the Levels of all Gemini monsters you control to that monster's original Level (enabling Rank 8s)..
Level 8 Gemini boss that cannot be negated on Normal Summon and banishes 1 Gemini from GY to destroy 1 card the opponent controls.
Level 8 Gemini that boosts ATK/DEF of other Geminis by 500 and protects Gemini monsters from destruction by destroying another card you control.
Core Field Spell that lets you Normal Summon Level 5+ Geminis without Tributing, grants an extra Gemini Normal Summon, and banishes a Gemini to pop an opponent's card.
Searches Catalyst Field, OR banishes a card you control to search Burnout and a Chemicritter monster simultaneously.
Unlocks Carbo Crab or Dioxogre's Gemini effects immediately and revives a Gemini from the GY when used for Link/Xyz Summons.
Archetypal Trap that banishes a face-up Chemicritter to summon 2 Chemicritters from the Deck and revives a banished Gemini when an opponent declares a direct attack.
Summons Dioxogre or Carbo Crab directly from the Deck during either player's turn with their effects active.
Summons Superalloy Beast Raptinus using GY Chemicritters.
extra: Rank 8 Xyz boss that revives a Gemini on Xyz Summon, protects Geminis from battle/targeting, and forces the opponent to send a card from hand/field to GY when a Gemini is Normal Summoned.
Level 8 Fusion that treats all face-up Gemini monsters on the field as Effect Monsters.
